dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop 'O' structures with stippled, high-contrast light-gray borders and dark-intensity centers. Edge perimeters show significant pixel-level crenulation and non-uniform widths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density; solid high-intensity pixels are primarily restricted to the stippled perimeters of the macro-annuli rather than forming independent large-scale solid clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral spanning the mid-section of the visible torso, with the longest axis parallel to the spine.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-saturation red-orange mark is visible on the posterior extremity near the junction of the hind flipper base.
